description: Execute a SQL query on a data source (SQLite, CSV, Parquet, or JSON file) and create a visualization from the results. The query must be read-only (SELECT only). You must specify how to map columns to the visualization.

columnMapping.description: Mapping of query result columns to chart axes. Not required for table type.

groupByColumn.description: Optional: Column to group by (alternative to seriesColumn)

seriesColumn.description: Optional: Column to group data into separate series (e.g., 'category', 'product_name')

xColumn.description: Column to use for X-axis (required for charts, not needed for table)

yColumns.description: Column(s) to use for Y-axis values (required for charts, not needed for table)

databasePath.description: Path to the data file (SQLite, CSV, Parquet, JSON)

query.description: SQL SELECT query to execute (read-only, max 10000 rows)

useColumnAsXLabel.description: If true, use the xColumn values as labels instead of numeric values (useful for dates/categories)

visualizationType.description: Type of visualization to create from the query results

name: queryAndVisualize
